skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations and knowledge about starting a new business.
Know the steps involved in starting a new business, including initial setup, funding, and management.
Understand the necessary resources for a business to operate effectively.
Be able to prepare financial support for a new business.
Understand basic business management activities such as human resource management, production, marketing, finance, and risk management.
Know strategies and challenges in growing and developing a new business.
Apply learned knowledge to assess specific situations related to starting a new business and provide feasible solutions.
Use critical thinking to solve problems in different industries and sectors.
Develop skills in writing reports, presenting, and defending reports.
Be proactive in learning and research.
Be proactive in group work sessions.
Support other members in the group.
Create a dynamic, flexible, and friendly learning environment.
